relationships.subject: PEDF
relationships.evidence_quote: Functioning as an endogenous anti-VEGF factor, PEDF plays crucial physiological roles, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, inhibition of VEGF-induced angiogenesis and thrombosis

relationships.subject: autologous platelet gel
relationships.evidence_quote: Group C exhibited the most prominent elevation in PEDF levels, and this difference was statistically significant when compared with both Group A and Group B (P< 0.05).

key_findings: APG plus negative pressure drainage and rh-aFGF gave the best wound healing in refractory diabetic foot ulcers.
Treatment reduced VEGF, MDA and inflammatory markers and raised SOD and PEDF in wound tissue.
